g.text: FastAPI backend 1. POST /v1/jobs/start → saves job in Postgres,
| stores zip + API key in Secrets Service
Job queue (RabbitMQ) 2. holds the job message
Instancer 3. picks up the message, starts one container per job
worker container 4. fetches bundle → unzips contracts to audit/
Codex agent 5. reads AGENTS.md, audits audit/ (max 3h)
worker check 7. "is it valid JSON?" → upload
Results Service 8. parses again → saves to Postgres
Vulnerability report 9. frontend polls status → renders JSON as report
